cleaner.label: Bazel cache
cleaner.description: Bazel output root: build results, external dependencies and install files of all workspaces.

option.label: Bazel output root
option.description: Removes all of Bazel's build state for the user, like `bazel clean --expunge` on every workspace.
option.warning: The next build starts from scratch and re-downloads external dependencies, which can take a long time. Shut down the Bazel server (`bazel shutdown`) before cleaning.
